intro: Notion for customer onboarding specialists on Mac provides a central hub to manage client transitions without switching between dozens of tabs. By organizing your databases and using Mac keyboard shortcuts, you can track every stage of the onboarding process from a single interface.
tldr: Use Notion databases to track client status and project milestones.
Master slash commands and Mac shortcuts to speed up documentation tasks.
Create reusable templates to standardize your onboarding flow for every new client.
Use Lazur on your Mac to dictate notes or ask about specific Notion features while you work.

blocks.text: The foundation of a good onboarding system is a master database. Create a new page and type /database to select a Table view. This will be your single source of truth for all active clients. Add properties for Status, Start Date, and Assigned CSM. You can then create different views for your board, such as a Kanban board to visualize the pipeline. This helps you see exactly where each client sits in their journey.

Efficiency on a Mac comes down to how well you use your keyboard. Notion relies on slash commands to keep your hands on the keys. Type / to see the menu of blocks. Use ⌘ + P to open the search bar and jump to any page in your workspace. Press Shift + ? to see the full list of shortcuts available in the desktop app. Learning these saves you minutes every hour by reducing mouse movement.

You should never build an onboarding plan from scratch. Create a database template for your client projects. Include a checklist of standard tasks, links to common resources, and placeholders for client specific info. When you add a new client to your database, click the arrow next to the blue New button and select your template. This ensures every client receives the same high quality experience while reducing your manual setup time.

Onboarding specialists often deal with a high volume of email and Slack messages. Instead of copy pasting information, use Notion to store your email templates. When you need to send an update, draft the response in a Notion block first. You can then copy it over to your mail client. If you find yourself repeating the same instructions, turn those into a dedicated FAQ page within your client workspace.

items: Use ⌘ + ⇧ + N to open a new Notion window if you need to reference two pages at once.
Keep the Notion desktop app updated via the Notion menu in the menu bar.
Use ⌘ + R to reload the app if you notice syncing delays or missing blocks.
Ensure your macOS is at least version 13 to maintain compatibility with the latest app features.

faq.question: How do I speed up my workflow in Notion?
faq.answer: Use slash commands by typing / to quickly add blocks. Master global search with ⌘ + P and use database templates to automate your setup.

faq.question: Can I use Lazur while working in Notion?
faq.answer: Yes. Hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask about a feature on your screen or use the fn key to dictate notes directly into your Notion pages.

faq.question: What are the system requirements for Notion on Mac?
faq.answer: You need macOS 13 or later to run the official Notion desktop app.
